description: A Helm chart for installing Kratix (https://kratix.io)

Vitess Operator: run Vitess (horizontally sharded MySQL) from VitessCluster resources, with vtgate, vttablet, vtctld, an etcd topology server, resharding and backups. The CRDs ship with the chart.
